name: Pizza Hut US
description: Discover Pizza Hut US stores and read menus, products, modifiers, bundles and the paginated store directory.

tools.name: Bundles
tools.description: Read Pizza Hut US bundles and their choices; optionally filter by bundle codes. For online deals and prices, keep only bundles whose redeemable_online and visible_online are true.

options.name: store_number
options.about: Zero-padded Pizza Hut US store number returned by stores or directory. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,20}$.

response.about: Read Pizza Hut US bundles and their choices; optionally filter by bundle codes. The list is the store's raw point-of-sale bundle set; each bundle carries the store's redeemable_online and visible_online flags, and bundles with either flag false are not orderable or shown on pizzahut.com.

tools.name: Category
tools.description: Read products, variants and bundles in a Pizza Hut US menu category. For online deals and prices, keep only bundles whose redeemable_online and visible_online are true.

options.name: include_modifiers
options.about: Include each variant's default-modifier tree (names, weights, prices, metafields). Off by default: default_modifiers is then null and the payload is a fraction of the size; use modifiers for the full tree of one product.

options.name: store_number
options.about: Zero-padded Pizza Hut US store number returned by stores or directory. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,20}$.

response.about: Read products, variants and bundles in a Pizza Hut US menu category. Categories such as deals return the store's raw point-of-sale bundle list; each bundle carries the store's redeemable_online and visible_online flags, and bundles with either flag false (POS-only, employee and other offline-only bundles) are not orderable or shown on pizzahut.com.

tools.name: Stores
tools.description: Discover nearby Pizza Hut stores and their store numbers, addresses, hours and supported occasions.

options.name: address
options.about: Street address to deliver to (e.g. `400 Pine St`); required with occasion DELIVERY and refused with CARRYOUT.

options.name: occasion
options.about: CARRYOUT (default) finds the nearest stores to postal_code. DELIVERY finds the stores that deliver to address in postal_code and requires address.

response.about: Find Pizza Hut US stores near a five-digit postal code for carryout, or the stores that deliver to a street address (occasion DELIVERY with address). Upstream returns the nearest stores regardless of distance: check postal_code_match, nearest_distance_miles and warnings before treating the first store as local.
